product_brief: An easy to use Aries agent for building SSI services using any language that supports sending/receiving HTTP requests.
key_management_model: Secure storage (for private keys, DIDs, credentials) managed per tenant in multi-tenant deployments; ACA-Py acts as a cloud/enterprise wallet
architecture_type: Server-side agent with HTTP/REST controller interface and webhooks (cloud/enterprise/IoT; not designed for mobile)
primary_platforms: Servers (cloud, enterprise, IoT devices); Docker; PyPi; Kubernetes
target_industries: Verifiable credential / decentralized identity ecosystems; enterprise
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Open source (Apache License 2.0); extensible via plug-ins (Aries ACA-Py Plugins repository); transitioning to OpenWallet Foundation
deployment_&_migration_complexity: LTS patch releases deployable without upgrade process; minor/major upgrade steps documented in CHANGELOG; Docker, PyPi, Kubernetes supported
organizational_readiness: Controller can be built in any language supporting HTTP requests; Python knowledge not needed; developer courses available (Linux Foundation edX)

evidence.Crypto Primitives: W3C Standard Verifiable Credential Data Model format using JSON-LD with LD-Signatures and BBS+ Signatures
evidence.Signature Schemes: W3C Standard Verifiable Credential Data Model format using JSON-LD with LD-Signatures and BBS+ Signatures
